2164efb1-1e83-41e4-b2f2-6d6a5ae19d3f.description:
“Partner Penjelajahan Dungeonku adalah Siswi SMA!?”

Masato, putra sulung keluarga Jingu, mulai hidup sebagai penjelajah di “Tokyo Dungeon” demi menghidupi adik-adiknya setelah kedua orang tuanya meninggal. Namun, ia merasa ada batas dalam beraktivitas sendirian, dan saat berpikir untuk mencari rekan demi menaklukkan dungeon, ia diperkenalkan kepada Tachibana Rika oleh adiknya, Rekka, lalu membentuk party bersamanya.

Keduanya menghadapi berbagai kesulitan, tetapi saat saling mendukung dan melewatinya bersama, hubungan mereka perlahan menjadi semakin dekat...!?

6b9bd81a-ae0f-4495-bde9-9ba20ee00981.title: Soshiki no Shukuteki to Kekkon Shitara Mecha Amai
6b9bd81a-ae0f-4495-bde9-9ba20ee00981.altTitle: I Married My Organization's Arch-Nemesis, and It's So Sweet!
6b9bd81a-ae0f-4495-bde9-9ba20ee00981.description:
"...I hate you!"
"What a coincidence. So do I."

The two once belonged to opposing organisations of supernatural power users, and fought for their own opposing goals. Roushi Saikawa, also known as the "Feather Hunter," and Ritsuka Yanagi, the strongest supernatural power user known as the "White Demon." The two spent their days battling each other and had no normal social experience, but...

"I love you, Rou-kun."
"Me too, Ritsuka."

After their organisation was disbanded, they somehow started dating and then got married! Is their hatred 100 times more adorable? Now, they are the epitome of a lovey-dovey couple, kissing each other at the door every morning when they go to work. But the husband had just one problem. That is, he had never shared a bed with his wife... In other words, even though he was married, he was still a virgin!

23ca8dca-5eec-4fbc-b755-6dbfc45cbd25.title: Scandal Maker ga Dorawatda
23ca8dca-5eec-4fbc-b755-6dbfc45cbd25.description: They call Harriet Listerwell the Scandal Maker, but the reputation was carefully crafted by her cousin Bella. At an imperial banquet, another of Bella’s schemes unfolds—framing Harriet in a way which insults the handsome and formidable Duke Cedric Kailas. Disgraced, Harriet is sent to a convent. In exile, she discovers a troubling truth: Bella’s family may have been behind the death of her parents. Now Harriet is returning to the glittering society that condemned her. The Scandal Maker is back—and this time, she intends to live up to the name.

99f8dc1e-a0d8-464d-980b-ee397724750d.title: Yami Sute Ana
99f8dc1e-a0d8-464d-980b-ee397724750d.description: “The Pit of Darkness”—an empty void that wipes anything thrown into it off the face of the Earth. Kasuga, a boy often taken advantage of by his peers for his diligent nature, happens upon a huge, bottomless pit during a field trip cleaning with his class. After accidentally dropping "something" inside, he realizes the pit possesses a strange power to... distort reality?!

091c1429-d7b6-48e2-85ec-79fabb1a44fb.title: Ikiru no Hetana Takou no Joshi
091c1429-d7b6-48e2-85ec-79fabb1a44fb.altTitle: A Girl from Another School Who's Not Very Good at Living
091c1429-d7b6-48e2-85ec-79fabb1a44fb.description: Kisah boy meets girl antara Mita, siswi SMA berwajah sangar namun ceroboh, dan Hitoyoshi, siswa SMA yang sangat penakut. Suatu pagi di kereta, Hitoyoshi tiba-tiba diajak bicara oleh Mita yang terlihat menyeramkan. Rupanya, Mita sedang merasa tidak enak badan. Meski ketakutan, Hitoyoshi tetap menolongnya. Sejak saat itu, ia mulai melihat sisi Mita yang ceroboh dan kikuk, jauh berbeda dari kesan yang diberikan oleh penampilannya.

114f08df-91de-4504-a5c7-8eaf51ff695c.title: Kitakubu Katsudou Kiroku
114f08df-91de-4504-a5c7-8eaf51ff695c.altTitle: Chronicles of the Going Home Club
114f08df-91de-4504-a5c7-8eaf51ff695c.description: When a friend asks Natsuki what high school club she's going to join, she cheerfully responds "the go-home club" (meaning, she's not going to join any of them). However, she soon realizes that this club actually exists at her high school, and she's just expressed interest in joining it! Before she knows it, she ends up as one of the two new members of "the go-home club," which is a small group of eccentric school girls. One of the girls likes fighting bears, while another is ridiculously rich. But what exactly constitutes the activities of "the go-home club"?
